spec.title: Consolidate CLI scripts into single dispatcher
spec.context:
The CLI scripts system has grown to 25+ individual TypeScript files, each compiled separately. This creates a 886-character build:scripts command in package.json, duplicate entry definitions (package.json overrides tsdown.config.ts), 39 output files in .festinalente/scripts/, and maintenance burden when adding new commands.
Consolidating into a single dispatcher entry point will simplify build configuration, reduce output files, and make adding new commands as simple as registering a function.

in-scope.item: Create single CLI dispatcher entry point with command routing
Implement DAG architecture: computers (pure logic) -> capabilities (I/O) -> orchestrator
Create shared utilities for argument parsing, error handling, file operations
Refactor search scripts into shared search engine library
Add zod schema validation for CLI arguments
Fix command injection vulnerability in check-freshness.ts using execFile
Simplify tsdown.config.ts to single entry point
Add --help command listing all available commands
Add error handling for unknown commands
Update all partials to use new dispatcher syntax (node .festinalente/scripts/festinalente.cjs {command} [args])
Update all skills that directly reference individual .cjs scripts

out-of-scope.item: Backwards compatibility with old script invocations
New CLI commands not in current 25 scripts

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide a single entry point `festinalente.cjs` that routes commands to appropriate handlers
The system shall return JSON output identical to the previous separate scripts for each command
The system shall display available commands when invoked with --help flag
The system shall return JSON error response with available commands when unknown command is invoked
The system shall validate CLI arguments using zod schemas before execution
The system shall use execFile instead of execSync for shell commands to prevent command injection
The system shall provide centralized error wrapper functions for file I/O operations returning Result types
The system shall consolidate search functionality into a shared search engine library
The system shall follow DAG architecture: computers -> capabilities -> orchestrator (no circular dependencies)
The system shall use factory-DI pattern for all shared utilities
All partials and skills shall be updated to use new invocation syntax: node .festinalente/scripts/festinalente.cjs {command} [args]

pattern.name: Orchestrator Pattern
pattern.description: Coordinates policy decisions and composes capabilities with computers. The CLI orchestrator routes command arguments to handlers.

pattern.name: Factory-DI Pattern
pattern.description: Use factory functions to inject dependencies for testability. Create handler factories that accept typed dependencies.

pattern.name: Tagged-Union-Errors
pattern.description: Return { error: true, message } or { success: true, data } for consistent JSON output across all commands.

pattern.name: Capability-Computer Separation
pattern.description: Capabilities handle I/O (file reads, git commands); Computers contain pure logic (parsing, search algorithms, validation).

pattern.name: Command Handler Registry
pattern.description: Define registry/map of command names to handler functions for routing.

pattern.name: Naming Conventions
pattern.description: Use suffixes: .computer.ts, .capability.ts, .orchestrator.ts for architectural layer categorization.

engineering.finding: 23+ Node.js scripts organized into 8 categories: finders, listers, searchers, validators, generators, getters, mutators, transformers. All return JSON output.
Orchestrators coordinate policy and compose capabilities - apply to CLI command routing.
Factory functions for DI - apply to handler creation.
All scripts should return consistent tagged-union results.

codebase.finding: 25 individual scripts totaling ~3,539 lines of code.
25 separate entry points with noExternal for bundled deps.
Used by 6 scripts (find-task, find-spec, find-plan, find-quick, list-tasks, delete-task).
5 partials reference individual .cjs scripts that must be updated to dispatcher syntax.
20 skill files reference individual .cjs scripts that must be updated to dispatcher syntax.

constraints.constraint: Scripts must be self-contained - all dependencies (gray-matter, fuse.js, js-yaml, fast-xml-parser, zod) bundled via noExternal
JSON output format must be preserved for compatibility with skill prompts
Exit codes (0 = success, 1 = error) must be preserved
Scripts reference .festinalente/ relative to working directory - maintain this behavior
Must follow DAG architecture - no circular dependencies between layers
